title: Reverse Bits
summary: Reverse all 32 bits of n, including the leading zeros.

contractDetails.constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 2147483646 and n is even, following the linked LeetCode contract. The 32-bit reversed word fits a signed nonnegative 32-bit integer.

statement: Reverse all 32 bits of n, including the leading zeros. Return the resulting word as a nonnegative integer.

examples.explanation: Bits 1 and 2 move to bits 30 and 29.

constraints: 0 ≤ n ≤ 2147483646 and n is even, following the linked LeetCode contract. The 32-bit reversed word fits a signed nonnegative 32-bit integer.
hints: Conceptual: The width stays 32 even when n has few significant bits.
Directional: Move the current low bit into the result as you shift both words.
Implementation: Perform exactly 32 rounds and use a logical right shift for the input.
complexityAnalysis: O(w) time and O(1) space, with w=32.
